dialin.title: Dial-in Doctor
dialin.subtitle: Extraction troubleshooting & sensory compensation
dialin.sourDesc: Sharp, vegetal, sour, quick finish. Not enough soluble compounds dissolved.
dialin.sourRemedy: Remedy: Grind finer, increase water temperature (+2°C), extend brew time, or increase ratio (e.g. 1:16.5).
dialin.bitterDesc: Ashy, astringent, harsh, lingering dry bitterness. Heavy tannins over-extracted.
dialin.bitterRemedy: Remedy: Grind coarser, lower water temperature (-2°C), reduce contact time, or minimize agitation.
dialin.balancedDesc: Clear natural sweetness, vibrant acidity, complex floral/fruity notes, clean finish.
dialin.ratioSubtitle: Bidirectional calculation: dose to water or target water to required bean dose.
dialin.costSubtitle: Real home specialty brewing cost vs specialty coffee shop benchmark.
dialin.issueDiagnosisSubtitle: Select the dominant flaw in the cup. The extraction compass will suggest precise grind and water temperature corrections.
dialin.issueSourDesc: Lack of sweetness, astringent finish, aggressive lemon acidity.
dialin.issueBitterDesc: Dry mouthfeel on tongue (ashy), hollow, harsh dark bitterness.
dialin.issueWeakDesc: Thin body, tea-like consistency without distinct sweetness.
dialin.issueTeaAstringentDesc: Water temperature was too high, scalding catechins and L-theanine.
dialin.normBalanceDesc: The cup is well within the standard extraction sweet spot.
dialin.eySubtitle: Calculate extraction yield based on refractometer TDS or estimates.
